06 Offline Synthetic Expansion¶

This notebook evaluates deterministic virtual synthetic add-back for optic disc and cup segmentation.

The core design is intentionally storage-light:

  • the original public-data manifest remains the only image/mask source;
  • synthetic training examples are generated on demand inside the training dataset;
  • validation and test data remain original and unaltered;
  • only lightweight training plans, summaries, histories, and comparison tables are saved.

# 06.02 — Project root and source path setup
def find_project_root(start: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    """Find the repository root from a notebook or terminal working directory."""
    current = (start or Path.cwd()).resolve()

    for candidate in [current, *current.parents]:
        if (candidate / ".git").exists() and (candidate / "src").exists():
            return candidate

    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find project root containing .git and src/.")


PROJECT_ROOT = find_project_root()
SRC_PATH = PROJECT_ROOT / "src"

if str(SRC_PATH) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC_PATH))

os.chdir(PROJECT_ROOT)

print(f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}")
print(f"Source path:  {SRC_PATH}")

06.07 — Select synthetic expansion candidates from Notebook 05 winners¶

Focus first on the strongest individual online-augmentation winners instead of bundled combined policies.

In [7]:
# 06.07 — Select synthetic expansion candidates from Notebook 05 winners
screen_summary = pd.read_csv(NOTEBOOK_05_OUTPUTS["screen_summary"])
model_baselines = pd.read_csv(NOTEBOOK_05_OUTPUTS["model_baselines"])

CORE_SYNTHETIC_CANDIDATES = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "run_name": "synthetic_unetplusplus_resnet18_small_affine_256px_5epoch",
            "model_name": "unetplusplus",
            "encoder_name": "resnet18",
            "strategy_name": "small_affine",
            "candidate_role": "best_overall_online_individual_result",
        },
        {
            "run_name": "synthetic_unet_resnet18_vignette_illumination_256px_5epoch",
            "model_name": "unet",
            "encoder_name": "resnet18",
            "strategy_name": "vignette_illumination",
            "candidate_role": "best_unet_online_individual_result",
        },
    ]
)


def first_existing_column(frame: pd.DataFrame, names: list[str]) -> str | None:
    """Return the first matching column name in a dataframe."""
    for name in names:
        if name in frame.columns:
            return name
    return None


def attach_notebook05_metrics(candidates: pd.DataFrame, screen: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Attach Notebook 05 online-screen metrics when matching columns are available."""
    model_col = first_existing_column(screen, ["model_name", "model"])
    encoder_col = first_existing_column(screen, ["encoder_name", "encoder"])
    strategy_col = first_existing_column(screen, ["strategy_name", "augmentation_strategy", "augmentation"])

    metric_cols = [
        col
        for col in [
            "best_val_mean_foreground_dice",
            "mean_foreground_dice",
            "delta_vs_model_baseline",
            "delta_mean_foreground_dice_vs_baseline",
            "meaningful_primary_improvement",
            "best_val_disc_dice",
            "best_val_cup_dice",
            "best_val_cdr_mae",
        ]
        if col in screen.columns
    ]

    if model_col is None or encoder_col is None or strategy_col is None:
        print("Notebook 05 screen summary columns:")
        print(list(screen.columns))
        print("Could not attach metrics automatically; candidate plan remains explicit.")
        return candidates

    slim = screen[[model_col, encoder_col, strategy_col, *metric_cols]].copy()
    slim = slim.rename(
        columns={
            model_col: "model_name",
            encoder_col: "encoder_name",
            strategy_col: "strategy_name",
        }
    )

    return candidates.merge(
        slim,
        on=["model_name", "encoder_name", "strategy_name"],
        how="left",
    )


synthetic_candidates = attach_notebook05_metrics(CORE_SYNTHETIC_CANDIDATES, screen_summary)

display(synthetic_candidates)

06.09 — Build virtual synthetic expansion datasets¶

Create storage-light virtual training datasets for the selected candidate strategies.

In [9]:
# 06.09 — Build virtual synthetic expansion datasets
virtual_train_datasets = {}
virtual_summary_rows = []

for candidate in synthetic_candidates.to_dict("records"):
    run_name = candidate["run_name"]
    strategy_name = candidate["strategy_name"]

    virtual_dataset = build_virtual_synthetic_expansion_dataset(
        datasets.train,
        strategy_names=strategy_name,
        copy_count=SYNTHETIC_COPY_COUNT,
        base_seed=SEED,
        include_original=True,
        add_metadata=True,
    )

    virtual_train_datasets[run_name] = virtual_dataset

    summary = virtual_dataset.summary().to_dict()
    summary.update(
        {
            "run_name": run_name,
            "model_name": candidate["model_name"],
            "encoder_name": candidate["encoder_name"],
            "strategy_name": strategy_name,
        }
    )
    virtual_summary_rows.append(summary)

virtual_expansion_summary = pd.DataFrame(virtual_summary_rows)
display(virtual_expansion_summary)

06.11 — Visual QA for virtual synthetic examples¶

Compare original training samples with their deterministic virtual synthetic counterparts.

In [11]:
# 06.11 — Visual QA for virtual synthetic examples
def tensor_image_to_numpy(image: torch.Tensor) -> np.ndarray:
    """Convert a CHW float tensor image to HWC numpy format for display."""
    return image.detach().cpu().permute(1, 2, 0).numpy().clip(0, 1)


def tensor_mask_to_numpy(mask: torch.Tensor) -> np.ndarray:
    """Convert a mask tensor to a numpy array for display."""
    return mask.detach().cpu().numpy()


example_source_indices = [0, 1, 2]
figure_rows = []

for source_index in example_source_indices:
    original_sample = qa_dataset[source_index]
    synthetic_sample = qa_dataset[len(datasets.train) + source_index]
    figure_rows.append((f"original {source_index}", original_sample))
    figure_rows.append((f"synthetic {source_index}", synthetic_sample))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(figure_rows), 2, figsize=(8, 3 * len(figure_rows)))

if len(figure_rows) == 1:
    axes = np.array([axes])

for row_index, (label, sample) in enumerate(figure_rows):
    axes[row_index, 0].imshow(tensor_image_to_numpy(sample["image"]))
    axes[row_index, 0].set_title(f"{label} image")
    axes[row_index, 0].axis("off")

    axes[row_index, 1].imshow(tensor_mask_to_numpy(sample["mask"]), vmin=0, vmax=2)
    axes[row_index, 1].set_title(f"{label} mask")
    axes[row_index, 1].axis("off")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

06.13 — Model and loss smoke test¶

Run one small forward/loss pass to verify that the virtual expanded data is compatible with the existing training stack.

In [13]:
# 06.13 — Model and loss smoke test
device = get_device()
device_info = describe_device(device)
print(device_info)

smoke_candidate = synthetic_candidates.iloc[0].to_dict()

smoke_model = build_model(
    model_name=smoke_candidate["model_name"],
    encoder_name=smoke_candidate["encoder_name"],
    encoder_weights=None,
    in_channels=3,
    classes=3,
)

criterion = DiceCELoss()

with torch.no_grad():
    smoke_logits = model_forward(smoke_model.to(device), smoke_images.to(device))
    smoke_loss = criterion(smoke_logits, smoke_masks.to(device))

model_smoke_summary = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "run_name": smoke_candidate["run_name"],
            "model_name": smoke_candidate["model_name"],
            "encoder_name": smoke_candidate["encoder_name"],
            "strategy_name": smoke_candidate["strategy_name"],
            "device": str(device),
            "logits_shape": str(tuple(smoke_logits.shape)),
            "smoke_loss": float(smoke_loss.detach().cpu().item()),
        }
    ]
)

display(model_smoke_summary)

del smoke_model, smoke_logits, smoke_loss
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

06.16 — Synthetic expansion training helpers¶

Define reusable helpers for the virtual synthetic add-back training runs. Each planned experiment will still be launched from its own notebook cell.

In [16]:
# 06.16 — Synthetic expansion training helpers
from glaucoma_segmentation.training.train_loop import fit_model_with_progress, history_to_dicts

LEARNING_RATE = 1e-4
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4

SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_PATH = TRAINING_REPORTS_DIR / "synthetic_expansion_training_history.csv"
SYNTHETIC_METADATA_PATH = TRAINING_REPORTS_DIR / "synthetic_expansion_run_metadata.csv"
SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH = TRAINING_REPORTS_DIR / "synthetic_expansion_summary.csv"


def mean_foreground_dice_from_columns(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Compute mean foreground Dice from disc and cup Dice columns."""
    return (frame["disc_dice"].astype(float) + frame["cup_dice"].astype(float)) / 2.0


def load_csv_if_exists(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Load a CSV if it exists; otherwise return an empty dataframe."""
    if path.exists():
        return pd.read_csv(path)
    return pd.DataFrame()


def remove_run_if_present(frame: pd.DataFrame, run_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Remove an existing run from a dataframe before overwriting it."""
    if frame.empty or "run_name" not in frame.columns:
        return frame
    return frame.loc[frame["run_name"] != run_name].copy()


def append_run_rows(path: Path, new_rows: pd.DataFrame, run_name: str, overwrite: bool) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Append run rows to a CSV, optionally replacing prior rows for the same run."""
    existing = load_csv_if_exists(path)

    if overwrite:
        existing = remove_run_if_present(existing, run_name)

    combined = pd.concat([existing, new_rows], ignore_index=True)
    combined.to_csv(path, index=False)
    return combined


def summarize_history_for_run(history_frame: pd.DataFrame, run_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return the Dice-first best validation row for one run."""
    if history_frame.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    run_history = history_frame.loc[history_frame["run_name"] == run_name].copy()
    val_history = run_history.loc[run_history["phase"] == "val"].copy()

    if val_history.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    val_history["val_mean_foreground_dice"] = mean_foreground_dice_from_columns(val_history)
    val_history = val_history.sort_values(
        ["val_mean_foreground_dice", "cup_dice", "disc_dice"],
        ascending=[False, False, False],
    )

    best = val_history.head(1).copy()
    best = best.rename(
        columns={
            "epoch": "best_epoch_by_val_mean_foreground_dice",
            "loss": "best_val_loss",
            "disc_dice": "best_val_disc_dice",
            "cup_dice": "best_val_cup_dice",
            "cdr_mae": "best_val_cdr_mae",
            "n_images": "val_images",
            "n_batches": "val_batches",
        }
    )

    return best[
        [
            "run_name",
            "best_epoch_by_val_mean_foreground_dice",
            "best_val_loss",
            "best_val_disc_dice",
            "best_val_cup_dice",
            "best_val_cdr_mae",
            "val_mean_foreground_dice",
            "val_images",
            "val_batches",
        ]
    ]


def candidate_for_run(run_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the training-plan row for a run name."""
    matches = synthetic_training_plan.loc[synthetic_training_plan["run_name"] == run_name]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected exactly one candidate for run_name={run_name!r}, got {len(matches)}.")

    return matches.iloc[0].to_dict()


def make_training_loaders_for_run(run_name: str) -> tuple[DataLoader, DataLoader]:
    """Build training and validation loaders for a virtual synthetic run."""
    train_dataset = virtual_train_datasets[run_name]

    train_generator = torch.Generator()
    train_generator.manual_seed(SEED)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=NUM_WORKERS,
        pin_memory=PIN_MEMORY,
        generator=train_generator,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    val_loader = DataLoader(
        datasets.val,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=NUM_WORKERS,
        pin_memory=PIN_MEMORY,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    return train_loader, val_loader


def run_virtual_synthetic_training(run_name: str, *, overwrite: bool = False) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Run one virtual synthetic expansion experiment and save lightweight results."""
    existing_history = load_csv_if_exists(SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_PATH)

    if (
        not overwrite
        and not existing_history.empty
        and "run_name" in existing_history.columns
        and run_name in set(existing_history["run_name"])
    ):
        print(f"Existing results found for {run_name}. Set overwrite=True to rerun.")
        existing_summary = summarize_history_for_run(existing_history, run_name)
        display(existing_summary)
        return existing_summary

    candidate = candidate_for_run(run_name)
    train_loader, val_loader = make_training_loaders_for_run(run_name)
    device = get_device()

    print(f"Run name: {run_name}")
    print(f"Model: {candidate['model_name']} / {candidate['encoder_name']}")
    print(f"Virtual synthetic strategy: {candidate['strategy_name']}")
    print(f"Training rows exposed: {len(virtual_train_datasets[run_name]):,}")
    print(f"Validation rows: {len(datasets.val):,}")
    print(f"Device: {device}")

    seed_everything(SEED, deterministic=False)

    model = build_model(
        model_name=candidate["model_name"],
        encoder_name=candidate["encoder_name"],
        encoder_weights=None,
        in_channels=3,
        classes=3,
    )

    criterion = DiceCELoss()
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=LEARNING_RATE,
        weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY,
    )

    start_time = time.perf_counter()

    history = fit_model_with_progress(
        model=model,
        train_loader=train_loader,
        val_loader=val_loader,
        criterion=criterion,
        optimizer=optimizer,
        device=device,
        epochs=EPOCHS,
        run_name=run_name,
        image_size=IMAGE_SIZE,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        print_epoch_summary=True,
        leave_progress=False,
    )

    elapsed_minutes = (time.perf_counter() - start_time) / 60.0

    history_frame = pd.DataFrame(history_to_dicts(history))
    history_frame.insert(0, "run_name", run_name)
    history_frame.insert(1, "model_name", candidate["model_name"])
    history_frame.insert(2, "encoder_name", candidate["encoder_name"])
    history_frame.insert(3, "strategy_name", candidate["strategy_name"])
    history_frame["augmentation_mode"] = "virtual_synthetic_add_back"
    history_frame["mean_foreground_dice"] = mean_foreground_dice_from_columns(history_frame)

    append_run_rows(SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_PATH, history_frame, run_name, overwrite=overwrite)

    metadata_frame = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "run_name": run_name,
                "model_name": candidate["model_name"],
                "encoder_name": candidate["encoder_name"],
                "strategy_name": candidate["strategy_name"],
                "augmentation_mode": "virtual_synthetic_add_back",
                "epochs": EPOCHS,
                "image_size": str(IMAGE_SIZE),
                "batch_size": BATCH_SIZE,
                "num_workers": NUM_WORKERS,
                "pin_memory": PIN_MEMORY,
                "learning_rate": LEARNING_RATE,
                "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
                "seed": SEED,
                "original_train_rows": len(datasets.train),
                "virtual_train_rows": len(virtual_train_datasets[run_name]),
                "validation_rows": len(datasets.val),
                "synthetic_copy_count": SYNTHETIC_COPY_COUNT,
                "materializes_synthetic_files": False,
                "total_fit_minutes": elapsed_minutes,
            }
        ]
    )

    append_run_rows(SYNTHETIC_METADATA_PATH, metadata_frame, run_name, overwrite=overwrite)

    all_history = load_csv_if_exists(SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_PATH)
    run_summary = summarize_history_for_run(all_history, run_name)
    display(run_summary)

    del model, optimizer, criterion
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return run_summary


print("Training helpers ready.")
print(f"History path:  {SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_PATH.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)}")
print(f"Metadata path: {SYNTHETIC_METADATA_PATH.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)}")
print(f"Summary path:  {SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)}")

Training helpers ready.
History path:  reports/training/synthetic_expansion_training_history.csv
Metadata path: reports/training/synthetic_expansion_run_metadata.csv
Summary path:  reports/training/synthetic_expansion_summary.csv

# 06.19 — Summarize synthetic expansion results
def prepare_model_baseline_reference(model_baselines: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Normalize Notebook 05 baseline columns for synthetic-expansion comparison."""
    frame = model_baselines.copy()

    rename_map = {}
    if "model" in frame.columns and "model_name" not in frame.columns:
        rename_map["model"] = "model_name"
    if "encoder" in frame.columns and "encoder_name" not in frame.columns:
        rename_map["encoder"] = "encoder_name"

    frame = frame.rename(columns=rename_map)

    required = ["model_name", "encoder_name"]
    missing_required = [column for column in required if column not in frame.columns]
    if missing_required:
        raise ValueError(
            "Notebook 05 model baseline table is missing required columns: "
            f"{missing_required}. Available columns: {list(frame.columns)}"
        )

    mean_col = first_existing_column(
        frame,
        [
            "baseline_val_mean_foreground_dice",
            "best_val_mean_foreground_dice",
            "baseline_mean_foreground_dice",
            "mean_foreground_dice",
            "best_mean_foreground_dice",
        ],
    )

    disc_col = first_existing_column(
        frame,
        [
            "baseline_val_disc_dice",
            "best_val_disc_dice",
            "baseline_disc_dice",
            "disc_dice",
        ],
    )

    cup_col = first_existing_column(
        frame,
        [
            "baseline_val_cup_dice",
            "best_val_cup_dice",
            "baseline_cup_dice",
            "cup_dice",
        ],
    )

    cdr_col = first_existing_column(
        frame,
        [
            "baseline_val_cdr_mae",
            "best_val_cdr_mae",
            "baseline_cdr_mae",
            "cdr_mae",
        ],
    )

    if mean_col is None and disc_col is not None and cup_col is not None:
        frame["computed_baseline_mean_foreground_dice"] = (
            frame[disc_col].astype(float) + frame[cup_col].astype(float)
        ) / 2.0
        mean_col = "computed_baseline_mean_foreground_dice"

    if mean_col is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "Could not identify or compute a mean foreground Dice column in model_baselines. "
            f"Available columns: {list(frame.columns)}"
        )

    keep = ["model_name", "encoder_name", mean_col]
    rename = {mean_col: "no_aug_baseline_mean_foreground_dice"}

    if disc_col is not None:
        keep.append(disc_col)
        rename[disc_col] = "no_aug_baseline_disc_dice"

    if cup_col is not None:
        keep.append(cup_col)
        rename[cup_col] = "no_aug_baseline_cup_dice"

    if cdr_col is not None:
        keep.append(cdr_col)
        rename[cdr_col] = "no_aug_baseline_cdr_mae"

    return (
        frame[keep]
        .rename(columns=rename)
        .drop_duplicates(["model_name", "encoder_name"])
    )


def prepare_online_reference(training_plan: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Prepare the Notebook 05 online-only reference for each planned run."""
    frame = training_plan.copy()

    frame = frame.rename(
        columns={
            "best_val_mean_foreground_dice": "online_reference_mean_foreground_dice",
            "best_val_disc_dice": "online_reference_disc_dice",
            "best_val_cup_dice": "online_reference_cup_dice",
            "best_val_cdr_mae": "online_reference_cdr_mae",
        }
    )

    required_columns = [
        "run_name",
        "model_name",
        "encoder_name",
        "strategy_name",
        "candidate_role",
        "online_reference_mean_foreground_dice",
        "online_reference_disc_dice",
        "online_reference_cup_dice",
        "online_reference_cdr_mae",
    ]

    missing = [column for column in required_columns if column not in frame.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            "Synthetic training plan is missing expected online-reference columns: "
            f"{missing}. Available columns: {list(frame.columns)}"
        )

    return frame[required_columns]


history_frame = load_csv_if_exists(SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_PATH)
metadata_frame = load_csv_if_exists(SYNTHETIC_METADATA_PATH)

if history_frame.empty:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "No synthetic expansion training history found. Run cells 06.17 and 06.18 first."
    )

summary_rows = []

for run_name in synthetic_training_plan["run_name"]:
    run_summary = summarize_history_for_run(history_frame, run_name)

    if not run_summary.empty:
        summary_rows.append(run_summary)

if not summary_rows:
    raise ValueError(
        "No completed synthetic-expansion validation summaries were found. "
        "Check synthetic_expansion_training_history.csv."
    )

synthetic_summary = pd.concat(summary_rows, ignore_index=True)

baseline_reference = prepare_model_baseline_reference(model_baselines)
online_reference = prepare_online_reference(synthetic_training_plan)

synthetic_summary = synthetic_summary.merge(
    synthetic_training_plan[
        [
            "run_name",
            "model_name",
            "encoder_name",
            "strategy_name",
            "candidate_role",
        ]
    ],
    on="run_name",
    how="left",
)

synthetic_summary = synthetic_summary.merge(
    baseline_reference,
    on=["model_name", "encoder_name"],
    how="left",
)

synthetic_summary = synthetic_summary.merge(
    online_reference,
    on=[
        "run_name",
        "model_name",
        "encoder_name",
        "strategy_name",
        "candidate_role",
    ],
    how="left",
)

if not metadata_frame.empty:
    synthetic_summary = synthetic_summary.merge(
        metadata_frame[
            [
                "run_name",
                "augmentation_mode",
                "original_train_rows",
                "virtual_train_rows",
                "synthetic_copy_count",
                "materializes_synthetic_files",
                "total_fit_minutes",
            ]
        ],
        on="run_name",
        how="left",
    )

synthetic_summary["delta_vs_no_aug_baseline"] = (
    synthetic_summary["val_mean_foreground_dice"]
    - synthetic_summary["no_aug_baseline_mean_foreground_dice"]
)

synthetic_summary["delta_vs_online_reference"] = (
    synthetic_summary["val_mean_foreground_dice"]
    - synthetic_summary["online_reference_mean_foreground_dice"]
)

synthetic_summary["meaningful_improvement_vs_baseline"] = (
    synthetic_summary["delta_vs_no_aug_baseline"] >= PRIMARY_DICE_IMPROVEMENT_THRESHOLD
)

synthetic_summary["meaningful_improvement_vs_online"] = (
    synthetic_summary["delta_vs_online_reference"] >= PRIMARY_DICE_IMPROVEMENT_THRESHOLD
)

synthetic_summary = synthetic_summary.sort_values(
    "val_mean_foreground_dice",
    ascending=False,
).reset_index(drop=True)

synthetic_summary.to_csv(SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH, index=False)

display(synthetic_summary)
print(f"Saved summary to {SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)}")

# 06.20 — Plot synthetic expansion comparisons
plot_frame = synthetic_summary[
    [
        "run_name",
        "no_aug_baseline_mean_foreground_dice",
        "online_reference_mean_foreground_dice",
        "val_mean_foreground_dice",
    ]
].copy()

plot_frame = plot_frame.rename(
    columns={
        "no_aug_baseline_mean_foreground_dice": "No augmentation baseline",
        "online_reference_mean_foreground_dice": "Notebook 05 online-only",
        "val_mean_foreground_dice": "Notebook 06 virtual synthetic add-back",
    }
)

plot_frame = plot_frame.set_index("run_name")

ax = plot_frame.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(12, 5))
ax.set_title("Notebook 06 virtual synthetic add-back comparison")
ax.set_ylabel("Mean foreground Dice")
ax.set_xlabel("Run")
ax.set_ylim(0.70, max(0.85, float(plot_frame.max().max()) + 0.02))
ax.legend(loc="lower right")

plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 06.21 — Final Notebook 06 handoff summary
completed_runs = set(load_csv_if_exists(SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_PATH).get("run_name", []))
planned_runs = set(synthetic_training_plan["run_name"])

handoff_rows = [
    {
        "item": "virtual synthetic design",
        "status": "complete",
        "detail": "synthetic samples are produced on demand; no expanded image/mask dataset is saved",
    },
    {
        "item": "planned core runs",
        "status": "complete" if planned_runs.issubset(completed_runs) else "partial",
        "detail": f"{len(completed_runs.intersection(planned_runs))} of {len(planned_runs)} planned runs completed",
    },
    {
        "item": "summary CSV",
        "status": "ready" if SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH.exists() else "pending",
        "detail": str(SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)),
    },
    {
        "item": "primary comparison",
        "status": "ready" if SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH.exists() else "pending",
        "detail": "compare virtual synthetic add-back against no-augmentation and online-only references",
    },
]

if SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH.exists():
    best_row = pd.read_csv(SYNTHETIC_SUMMARY_PATH).sort_values(
        "val_mean_foreground_dice",
        ascending=False,
    ).head(1)

    if not best_row.empty:
        handoff_rows.append(
            {
                "item": "best Notebook 06 run",
                "status": "identified",
                "detail": (
                    f"{best_row.iloc[0]['run_name']} "
                    f"mean Dice={best_row.iloc[0]['val_mean_foreground_dice']:.4f}"
                ),
            }
        )

handoff = pd.DataFrame(handoff_rows)
display(handoff)
